note: Numpad notation, facing right: 6 = forward, 4 = back, 2 = down, 8 = up, 236 = quarter circle forward. Craft Gauge: 4 bars, kept between rounds. EX = 1 bar, supers = 3 bars. Overdrive: more damage and Craft Gauge until the Burst gauge runs out.

sections.title: Normals
moves: Rising Slash: launches; any normal cancels into it; jump (8) on hit to chase

sections.title: Specials
moves: Stationary quickdraw: A cuts straight ahead with a long lightning slash; B cuts diagonally upward (anti-air, launches)
1 bar. Stationary rapid slash barrage, 6 hits; the last one blasts them away (hard knockdown)
A: short dash, B: longer dash. The dash itself doesn't hit
a palm strike out of either dash
C during the dash (or hold B)
She slashes through them and ends up on the other side. Very unsafe on block. On hit she sheathes her sword and they are lifted slightly; a counter hit gives extra time to follow up
invincible lightning dash; on hit she slashes through them again and again (the old EX Dash Slash)
Invincible start, sweeps forward and launches
1 bar. Two-hit X cut that launches them, then she teleports above them and drops straight down with a slash that drives them into the floor (hard knockdown); without 1 bar = B
Diving slash; slams airborne opponents down
1 bar. Invincible dive; the lightning X on landing is a pillar that launches them (+3 on block)

sections.title: Supers (3 bars)
moves: Ground or air. In the air she plunges down: anyone she touches on the way is dragged to the floor and takes the whole surge
Counter stance; when it catches a hit she crosses through them four times (one hit) and sheathes on her own side

sections.title: System
moves: full Burst gauge, works in hitstun
On the ground: dash forward, or back dash with back held. In the air: air dash forward, or back with back held
